speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with sudden-onset vertigo; to help me understand your condition, how long have you been experiencing these spinning sensations?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The brief 3-minute duration and sudden onset upon changing position are highly characteristic of BPPV. To confirm this, I would like to perform the Dix-Hallpike maneuver; do you have any other medical conditions or take medications that might affect your inner ear?
